paragraphs: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Beteira: in the Mishnah, Shabbat 12:5 (104b), Yevamot 8:4, Eduyot 8:1, and Parah 2:5. He is the unqualified ‘Ben Beteira’—see his entry. Before he was ordained he was called simply Ben Beteira, and sometimes he is called by his personal name: Taanit 3a. [Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak gives this explanation for two attributions in the rain discussion.] ‘Rabbi Yehoshua and Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira testified’: Menachot 103b, end. [The checked Menachot reads “Rabbi Yehoshua and Rabbi Yehoshua ben Beteira” in the testimony about carcass blood.] See Yevamot 79, Ketubbot 14, and Kiddushin 75. His brothers were Rabbi Yehudah and Rabbi Shimon; see their entries.
